name: talentrix
description: TalentriX — connect employers, hubs and job seekers

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && cp -n backend/.env.example backend/.env 2>/dev/null; npm install --prefix frontend && cp -n frontend/.env.example frontend/.env 2>/dev/null; echo 'Setup complete. Run: npm run dev'
scripts.dev: npx concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
